description: This PHP class 'FormatWithGender' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format entity values based on employee gender. It accesses the static 'GENDER' array from the Employee class to retrieve gender labels.

classes.name: FormatWithGender
classes.description: A class that formats employee gender values based on a predefined static array in the Employee class.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the gender label corresponding to the provided entity value, or null if not found.
